# Brushline

> Agent-facing index for Brushline. Read the linked pages before you change the project.

## Start here

- [Home](index.html): the documentation home for the project.
- [Design record](design/index.html): the scope, architecture, optimization, UI, LiDAR, instance-builder, demo-portal, and literature review decisions.
- [Contract index](reference/contract-index.html): every schema, validator, error prefix, and test layer.
- [FEMIC extension boundary](reference/femic-boundary.html): exact pins, providers, nodes, commands, contracts, and drift policy.
- [Instance template](reference/instance-template.html): the Brushline overlay, the two rebuild specs, configuration, and validation.
- [FreshForge provider](reference/freshforge-provider.html): the six Brushline nodes, their commands, validation, and offline tests.
- [Data catalogue and connectors](reference/data-catalogue.html): public sources, private connectors, licences, classifications, the secret scan, and the agent approval gate.
- [Fetch plan, materialization, and coverage](reference/fetch-plan.html): plan-only estimates, bulk approval, checksums, pointers, six coverage states, and the gap decision.
- [Agent capabilities](reference/agent-capabilities.html): the six bounded capabilities, tool allowlists, validators, retry budgets, and sanitized outcome records.
- [Model builder](reference/model-builder.html): the map-to-instance prototype, plan preview, approvals, dry run, progress stream, review, and handoff.
- [FEMIC LiDAR bundle](reference/lidar-bundle.html): the read-only producer bundle contract, manifest and selection checks, product provenance, and named errors.
- [Terrain and slope support](reference/terrain-support.html): buffered segment aggregation, slope, aspect, terrain classes, the access proxy, and coverage states.
- [Canopy and cover support](reference/canopy-support.html): CHM height and cover statistics, optional structure and tree products, VRI comparison, and applicability states.
- [Initial vegetation state](reference/state-initialization.html): field-first rules, conservative CHM thresholds, explicit unknown/partial states, class probabilities, and audit decisions.
- [LiDAR coverage and applicability](reference/lidar-coverage.html): acquisition recency, usable coverage, domain checks, missing observation gaps, and the stop/continue decision.
- [LiDAR benchmark](reference/lidar-benchmark.html): the offline FEMIC/WS4/FHOPS comparison, shared measurement contract, tolerances, missing-value rules, and report statuses.
- [Low-vegetation state space](reference/state-space.html): functional groups, variables, discretization, class probabilities, uncertainty, and projection to the state contract.
- [Growth model](reference/growth-model.html): saturating group-specific growth, site/climate/competition modifiers, uncertainty, and the out-of-domain rule.
- [Treatment transitions](reference/treatment-transitions.html): method and season priors, top-kill, resprouting, regrowth delay, cost hooks, and the post-delay trajectory.
- [Treatment calibration](reference/treatment-calibration.html): before/after evidence, pooling, shrinkage, intervals, leave-one-out checks, and calibrated parameters.
- [Hazard and service indicators](reference/hazard-indicators.html): clearance, fall-in, fuel connectivity, access, reliability weights, formulas, and caveats.
- [Held-out vegetation validation](reference/vegetation-validation.html): spatial holdout, group error, interval coverage, time-lag sensitivity, and candidate benchmark.
- [Low-vegetation model card](reference/low-vegetation-model-card.html): predictors, evidence, metrics, uncertainty, applicability domain, and out-of-domain rejection.
- [Optimization formulation](reference/optimization-formulation.html): variables, treatment/monitoring options, constraints, and the four-objective vector.
- [Optimization evaluator](reference/optimization-evaluator.html): exact replay, objectives, costs, violations, and the full-evaluation fallback.
- [Optimization move operators](reference/optimization-operators.html): toggle, method, shift, swap, block, monitoring, destroy-repair, locks, access, and repair.
- [Optimization adapter and replay](reference/optimization-adapter.html): the Fresh Solutions contract, scalarizations, search modes, checkpoints, and exact replay.
- [Multi-objective archive](reference/optimization-archive.html): non-dominance, crowding, eviction, pareto.json, and promotion records.
- [Compiled dataset contract](reference/compiled-dataset.html): the manifest, table, column, and validation contract.
- [Corridor graph contract](reference/corridor-contract.html): corridors, segments, spans, treatment units, access, structures, and service standards.
- [State and treatment contract](reference/state-contract.html): vegetation states, treatments, transitions, observations, ranges, and referential checks.
- [Artifact contracts](reference/artifacts.html): plan, run, Pareto archive, operations timeline, and demo manifest.
- [Synthetic corridor fixture](reference/synthetic-fixture.html): the deterministic two-corridor example, expected values, warnings, and tiny known optimum.
- [Prototype compile and simulate](reference/prototype.html): the end-to-end CLI, prototype growth and treatment rules, accounts, and run artifacts.
- [API reference](api/index.html): every public function, with its parameters, types, and return values.
- [brushline package](api/brushline.html): the package root and the command line.
- [dataset schema](api/model.html): the dataset models and validator.
- [corridor schema](api/corridor.html): the corridor graph models and validator.
- [state schema](api/state.html): the vegetation state, treatment, transition, and observation models.
- [artifact schemas](api/artifacts.html): the plan, run, Pareto archive, timeline, demo, and validation models.
- [prototype API](api/prototype.html): the compiler, simulator, schedule, and run writer.
- [FEMIC boundary API](api/femic.html): the boundary constants, compatibility report, and pin validator.
- [instance template API](api/instance.html): the template installer and result.
- [FreshForge provider API](api/freshforge.html): the provider metadata, validation, and execution hooks.
- [Data catalogue API](api/catalogue.html): source and connector models, validation, agent metadata, and connection tests.
- [Fetch plan API](api/fetch.html): the planner, materialization checks, coverage states, and the gap report.
- [Agent capabilities API](api/capabilities.html): the registry, fake provider, harness, validators, and scans.
- [Model builder API](api/model-builder.html): the session store, FastAPI routes, plan preview, approvals, dry run, review, and handoff.
- [LiDAR bundle API](api/lidar.html): the manifest models, bundle validator, provenance, and reference writer.
- [Terrain support API](api/terrain.html): the raster contract, segment buffer, aggregation, and validator.
- [Canopy support API](api/canopy.html): the CHM contract, aggregation, tree and VRI models, and validator.
- [State initialization API](api/state-init.html): the evidence models, initializer, decisions, and validator.
- [LiDAR coverage API](api/lidar-coverage.html): the evidence/coverage models, assessment, and validator.
- [LiDAR benchmark API](api/lidar-benchmark.html): the benchmark request, cases, runner, and validator.
- [State space API](api/state-space.html): the profiles, distributions, observation projection, and validator.
- [Growth API](api/growth.html): the parameters, request/result models, growth step, and validator.
- [Treatment API](api/treatment.html): the parameters, request/result models, transition, and validator.
- [Treatment calibration API](api/treatment-calibration.html): the evidence/calibrated models, fitter, and validator.
- [Hazards API](api/hazards.html): the input/config/indicator/report models and validator.
- [Vegetation validation API](api/vegetation-validation.html): the dataset, metrics, lag and candidate summaries, and validator.
- [Model card API](api/model-card.html): the card, domain check, evidence, uncertainty, and validator.
- [Optimization formulation API](api/optimization-formulation.html): the formulation models, builder, and validator.
- [Optimization evaluator API](api/optimization-evaluator.html): the exact evaluator, result, context, and incremental wrapper.
- [Optimization move operators API](api/optimization-operators.html): typed moves, operators, and repair.
- [Optimization adapter API](api/optimization-adapter.html): the adapter, scalarizations, search runs, and checkpoints.
- [Multi-objective archive API](api/optimization-archive.html): the archive builder, writers, and promotion.
